available.quote: Any person who shall present to the board a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in podiatry or in medicine in any other state, where the requirements for registration are in the opinion of the board equivalent to those of this commonwealth, may be registered and given a certificate of registration in this commonwealth without a written examination

requirements.value: Out-of-state registrant must have requirements equivalent to MA, the other state must accord like privilege to MA holders, the applicant must not have previously failed the MA examination, must have been in reputable practice of podiatry continuously for not less than five years immediately preceding the application, and must intend to reside and practice podiatry in MA.
